name: SPARZ SKL019 Analog Desk Phone
description: The SKL019 is a smart and efficient corded phone for business and office environments. It features DTMF/FSK Caller ID, HD hands-free calling, a built-in calculator, programmable ringtones, volume control, call history memory, alarm functions, one-touch dialing, and intelligent call filtering.
specs: Caller ID and time record memory

name: SPARZ SKL101 Business Telephone
description: The SKL101 is a compact, reliable corded landline phone for home and office use. Caller ID, an easy-to-read display, clear audio, call history memory, redial, and an ergonomic keypad make it dependable for reception areas, staff cabins, and everyday calling.
specs: Incoming call memory up to 50 groups
Outgoing call memory up to 14 groups
LCD date and time display with 5 brightness levels

name: SPARZ SKL1026 Office Phone
description: The SKL1026 is a reliable corded business phone with Caller ID for offices, call centers, and professional environments. It combines clear caller ID, voice clarity, a user-friendly design, and dependable operation without batteries or an adaptor.
specs: Incoming call memory up to 38 groups
Outgoing call memory up to 12 groups

name: SPARZ SKL1028 Executive Phone
description: The SKL1028 is a feature-rich corded business phone built for front desks, administrative offices, and support centers. Its Caller ID, clear LCD display, ergonomic keypad, and stable corded connection support reliable high-volume communication.

name: SPARZ SKL1382 Hospitality Phone
description: The SKL1382 Analog Phone is a premium desk phone for small businesses, offices, and enterprises that demand reliability and efficiency. Its clear LCD display, DSS keys, and adjustable angle bracket support smooth call management and comfortable everyday communication.
specs: Incoming call memory up to 38 groups
Outgoing call memory up to 12 groups

name: SPARZ SKL1038 Business Phone
description: A dependable corded business phone designed for clear, efficient communication across professional workspaces.

name: SPARZ KX-T888 Retro Wall Phone
description: The SPARZ KX-T888 is a retro wall-mountable analog phone for hotels, homes, and offices, combining classic styling with a modern LCD display and reliable corded performance.
specs: Available in black, red, and white
